user.title: Gas market
user.description: Search your ZIP on pagasswitch.com and copy the `distributor=` number from the results page URL.

data_description.price_unit: Leave blank to read it from the PA Gas Switch shop page (Peoples quotes per Mcf).

settings.title: Your usage and rate
settings.description: Pick the long-term statistic with your gas use (for example Peoples Gas consumption) and where your current supply rate comes from. With neither a sensor nor a value, the utility's Price to Compare is used.

data.current_rate_unit: Unit of the rate you typed
data.threshold_pct: Recommend switching at savings of at least
data.no_cancellation_fee: Skip offers with a cancellation fee

data_description.current_rate_entity: A sensor in USD per Mcf, ccf or therm, such as Peoples Gas Price to Compare. Takes precedence over a typed rate.
data_description.prior_suppliers: Semicolon-separated, optionally with the date you left: `Name@YYYY-MM-DD; Other Name`. Their new-customer-only offers are skipped.

error.no_offers: PA Gas Switch lists no offers for that distributor and service type.
error.unknown_unit: PA Gas Switch didn't show a Price to Compare for this ZIP and distributor, so the price unit is unknown. Pick it here.

abort.already_configured: This gas market is already set up.

data.current_rate_unit: Unit of the rate you typed
data.threshold_pct: Recommend switching at savings of at least
data.no_cancellation_fee: Skip offers with a cancellation fee
data.rate_jump_pct: Flag a rise in your rate of at least

cheaper_gas_supplier.title: Cheaper gas supplier: {supplier}
cheaper_gas_supplier.description:
{supplier} ({plan}, {term}) is ${price}/{unit} against your ${baseline}/{unit}, about ${savings} a year ({pct}%) less on your usage.

To switch, call {phone} or use the PA Gas Switch listing. Check the term, any cancellation fee and whether the price is introductory before signing.

This goes away on its own when the offer stops being worth it. Ignoring it silences this supplier only.

gas_rate_jump.title: Your gas supply rate rose {pct}%
gas_rate_jump.description: Your supply rate went from ${old}/{unit} (on {old_date}) to ${new}/{unit}. Variable rates often reset like this; the Energy Shopper sensors show whether another offer is cheaper now.
